declared_before: any measurement result, fit, or final render existed for this clip
note: Generic Video-to-Physics acceptance derived from clip 01. Clip-specific checks may be ADDED by the lead before fitting; tolerances are never relaxed after a failure.

physics_validation.P1_convergence: production integrator at >=3 resolutions: max difference between the two finest < 1e-7 (rad or m as appropriate) over 0-10 s; observed order within 0.5 of theory (or within the documented order for event/contact solvers)
physics_validation.P2_independent_benchmark: verifier's independently written solver (different method, no imports from solver/) vs production at identical params: max state difference < 1e-6 (rad / m); contact event times within 1e-6 s
physics_validation.P3_analytic_limit: an exact or asymptotic analytic result valid for this mechanism (e.g. linear-oscillator period, elliptic period, rolling acceleration a=g sin(b)/(1+I/mr^2), restitution height ratio e^2) matched to < 1e-7 relative in its regime of validity
physics_validation.P4_energy: conservative-case drift |dE|/E0 < 1e-8; damped/contact energy balance residual < 1e-7 E0 (per declared dissipation terms); no per-sample energy increase > 1e-12 E0 except where an external work term is declared
physics_validation.P5_constraints_saved_blend: reopened saved .blend evaluated at frames + 4 subframes: fixed anchors drift < 1e-6 m; declared constraints (lengths, attachments, rolling contact, non-penetration) hold to < 1e-6 m (1e-5 m for visual attachments)
physics_validation.P6_blend_vs_solver: evaluated Blender transforms vs validated solver at frames and 4 subframes per frame: < 1e-5 rad / 1e-5 m
physics_validation.P7_forces: constraint/contact forces physically admissible (tension >= 0, normal force >= 0 in contact, friction within cone if declared)
physics_validation.P8_initial_conditions_time: initial state equals params; frame n <-> t=n/24 exactly; no time scaling
physics_validation.P9_control_response: parameter changes run through the real build path change the dynamics as the equations predict (relative error < 1e-4 or regime-appropriate)
physics_validation.P10_repeatability: two clean rebuilds: identical keyframe arrays and evaluated transforms

reference_fidelity.note: Reported separately; the AI reference is not ground truth.
reference_fidelity.R1: per-frame tracking uncertainty from two independent methods
reference_fidelity.R2_anchor: projected model vs track RMS inside the opening anchor window: target <= max(2 px, 3 sigma)
reference_fidelity.R3_divergence: after the anchor window: reported as a divergence map with named AI defects (not a pass/fail target)
reference_fidelity.R5_render_track: tracked object in the final render vs model projection RMS <= 1 px (render reproduces the simulation)

visual_review.V1: no shape change, attachment sliding, interpenetration, flicker or popping in dense strips at turning points/contacts
visual_review.V2: all visible parts present and readable; materials match the reference by region metrics
visual_review.V3: side-by-side at identical physical times, no retiming; static silhouette IoU >= 0.9
visual_review.V4: observed vs hypothesis vs untested are separated
